# Global Design Skill

> Portable design operating system for AI-assisted frontend development. It helps AI coding assistants produce stricter UI/UX reviews, better frontend handoff specs, and less generic interface output.

## Primary Repository

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/staurus86/global-design-skill)
- [Installation guide](https://github.com/staurus86/global-design-skill/blob/master/install.md)
- [Core skill entry point](https://github.com/staurus86/global-design-skill/blob/master/skills/global-design/SKILL.md)
- [Manifest](https://github.com/staurus86/global-design-skill/blob/master/manifest.yaml)

## Compatible AI Tools

- Claude Code
- Cursor
- Codex
- ChatGPT Custom GPTs
- Windsurf
- GitHub Copilot
- Any AI coding assistant that can read repository context

## Main Use Cases

- Audit live URLs, screenshots, HTML, and generated UI
- Redesign generic landing pages and SaaS heroes
- Build admin panels and product dashboards
- Improve forms, pricing pages, navigation, empty states, and loading states
- Specify accessibility, responsive behavior, tokens, and frontend implementation details
- Produce developer-ready handoff specs
